title: OpenClaw
intro: OpenClaw's agent in exec mode: one JSON envelope per turn with the answer and usage. Continuity is the state directory kept with the session, since exec cannot name a prior session.

verified.how: hg harness run against DeepSeek; exec starts a new agent session per turn (the workspace carries over, the conversation does not); one envelope, no stream

notes: OpenClaw needs Node 24; install.sh puts a private Node under the tools layer.
The provider is written into a per-turn config file (models.providers.hg) with the gateway as baseUrl; --config pins it, so nothing ambient applies.
exec emits no events while it runs: the response arrives whole, and tool calls appear only as counts in its summary.
